scope: Synthetic gameplay score and turn-summary parameters for the Phase 8 text-game package. This authority does not select physics equations, alter solver contracts, or establish production/reference tolerances.

source_authority.coverage_reason: The task selects only player-facing score weights, normalized proxy quality measures, deterministic rounding, and cause/effect summary wording. It does not select a reactor equation, physical constant, nuclear-data value, reference case, or golden numerical tolerance.

approval_must_confirm: The scoring values are synthetic gameplay weights and are not physical measurements or reference tolerances.
All score inputs are derived from the approved P8-T02 normalized proxy state, explicit simulation time, committed action records, and scripted event/loss records.
Energy and stability quality use the deterministic trapezoid over each explicit advance window; no solver equation is changed.
Fuelling efficiency is a request-budget conservation proxy until a separately approved refuelling-command task exists.
Score totals are clamped to [0,1000] and rounded to three decimal places for stable display and comparison.
Turn summaries expose cause/effect and bounded state deltas without exposing raw solver internals.
Save/load, replay, scripted bots, long-run soak, Unity presentation, and G8 evidence remain separate tasks.

units.simulation_time_s: Explicit gameplay seconds from P8-T02; not a solver timestep authority.

score_model.stability_quality_formula: clamp(sum(state_segment_stability_quality * segment_duration_s) / scenario_horizon_s, 0, 1); state_segment_stability_quality = clamp(1 - abs(state_segment_normalized_power_fraction - nominal_power_fraction) - state_segment_absolute_tilt_fraction - abs(state_segment_control_margin_fraction), 0, 1)
score_model.fuelling_efficiency_formula: clamp(refuel_requests_remaining / initial_refuel_requests_remaining, 0, 1); if the initial budget is zero, use 1
score_model.survival_formula: 1 when the scenario reaches its approved horizon; otherwise 0

summary_model.cause_policy: Prefer loss identifiers, then scripted event kinds, then committed player action kinds, otherwise report elapsed play.
summary_model.effect_policy: Describe only approved proxy deltas, score movement, or scenario outcome; never claim a physical plant response.
